theater: 青海湖東岸與河州邊境

battle.name: 隋擊降党項之戰
battle.theater: 青海湖東岸與河州邊境
battle.brief: 開皇十五年（595）二月，隋文帝以蜀王楊秀為行軍總管，率步騎二十餘萬出益州，北上松州，進軍青海湖一帶，討吐谷渾與黨項。隋軍大破於星宿川，伏允遁走，黨項各部首領相率降附，隋置郡縣編其眾。卡面亞述長矛為短柄鐵鏃之祖，隋軍步卒鐵矛、騎兵馬槊皆承其形制。

kit.name: 亞述長矛
kit.history: 短柄、長刃，配著鐵鏃。亞述人把它和弓、鐵器綁在一起，兩河流域的城一個接一個陷落。

countries: 交戰的一方是隋朝。開皇十五年（595）時的隋朝剛剛平定陳朝不久，由文帝楊堅坐鎮關中，朝廷以行軍總管總攝兵權、諸軍總管分道而進、各州郡以太守與校尉供應兵糧的體制調度大軍。這次出征掛名的是蜀王楊秀，他同時身任益州總管，統攝主力；總管府中有楊素、楊爽等王府與尚書省將佐隨行參贊，河西一線另有涼州、河州、鄯州、廓州各處邊軍配合，構成南北夾擊之勢。另一方是吐谷渾與黨項。吐谷渾以慕容氏為都汗，控弦之士眾多，牧地在青海湖兩岸的高原；黨項則是分居河州、鄯州、廓州、疊州一帶的羌族系部落，首領多自稱帥或渠帥，各領帳落，部眾以遊牧為本、兼營農耕，並不統一隸屬於吐谷渾，而是與之既合作又競爭。隋廷把黨項視為可以招撫、可以編管的邊緣部族，因此本役記載的重點落在「招撫」而不是「屠滅」上，這一取向決定了整場戰爭的收場方式。
countriesEn: One side was the Sui. In 595, the year of Kaihuang 15, the dynasty had only just finished the conquest of Chen in 589, and Emperor Wen Yang Jian ruled from the Guanzhong plain. The Sui mustered through the system that suited it: a xingjun zongguan (行軍總管, expeditionary commander-in-chief) to hold overall command, subordinate zhongguan in charge of individual columns, and taishou and xiaowei drawing troops and grain from the prefectures. The name on the order was that of the Shu prince Yang Xiu, simultaneously Inspectorate of Yizhou, and the columns that actually marched north were his. Yang Su, Yang Shuang and other officers of the prince's staff and of the Department of State Affairs served under him, while a second force operated out of Liangzhou, Hezhou, Shanzhou and Kuozhou, so that the enemy was pinched from two directions. The other side was the Tuyuhun and the Tangut. The Tuyuhun, ruled by the Murong clan, held the pastures on both shores of Qinghai Lake and could put a great many men on horseback. The Tangut were a cluster of Qiangic tribes living around Hezhou, Shanzhou, Kuozhou and Diezhou, their chiefs styling themselves shuai or qu-shuai, each with its own tent-clans; they were herders who also tilled patches of ground, and they were not consistently subject to the Tuyuhun but alternated between alliance and rivalry with them. The Sui court regarded the Tangut as people who could be won over and administered rather than destroyed, and that orientation decided how the campaign ended.
people: 隋文帝楊堅是這場戰爭的決策者：下詔發兵的時點、兵力的配置，以及對降附者授官編戶的處置，都出自中樞。蜀王楊秀是掛名的行軍總管，真正指揮那支自益州北上的大軍，他的責任是把兵帶過松州與羌區的山道，攻入青海。行軍總管府之中，楊素等將佐參贊軍務，分別掌管分道、行軍序列與糧秣轉運。吐谷渾方面的直接對手是都汗伏允：戰前他倚仗草場與游騎不與隋軍正面決戰，兵敗之後收拾殘部退入祁連山與積石山的深處，其後又捲土重來，直到大業年間才被隋廷處置，吐谷渾的國勢才由此衰落。黨項方面則有一層明顯的遺憾：史書記述降附時多以「黨項帥率眾內附」一語帶過，首領姓名、兵眾數目與受降的具體經過都沒有留下文字，與伏允那條可以一路追到十年之後的線索相比，黨項人是這場戰爭裡最沉默的一方；他們在名冊上出現的方式，是「內附」二字。
peopleEn: Emperor Wen Yang Jian was the man who decided: the moment the army was launched, how it was divided, and how the surrendered were to be ranked and resettled all came from the central government. The Shu prince Yang Xiu held the title of xingjun zongguan, and the real command of the host that marched north from Yizhou was his, with the responsibility of carrying it over the passes of Songzhou and the Qiang country into Qinghai. Around him, Yang Su and other commanders of the 行軍總管府 handled the details of routing, the marching order and the transport of provisions. On the Tuyuhun side the direct opponent was the khagan Fu Yun, who had relied on the pastures and his mobile riders to refuse a set-piece battle; after his defeat he gathered what was left of his people and withdrew into the deep recesses of the Qilian and Jishi mountains, and he came back to the frontier years later, until the Sui court finally removed him in the Daye years and the Tuyuhun state declined from that point. The Tangut are the silent party of the story. When the histories record the submission they compress it into a single formula, to the effect that the Tangut chiefs came in with their followers; the names of the chiefs, the size of the following and the manner of the surrender were all left unwritten. Compared with Fu Yun, whose flight and removal the annals follow for a decade, the Tangut appear only as a line.
kits: 卡面這件亞述長矛是短柄、長刃、配鐵鏃的套筒式長矛，形制上與中國先秦的戈矛同源，差別只在亞述人把它與弓、鐵器綁在一處，作為攻守皆可的通用兵器；到了隋代，這一類短柄套筒矛早已被更簡潔的鐵矛與素鐵鏃取代，亞述長矛本身不會出現在河西的戰場上，但它所代表的是一名矛卒的全部裝備。隋軍這支部隊的配備可以這樣看：步兵以鐵矛、戈、戟為主，盾有板楯一類小盾，弓弩有臂弓與蹶張弩，鎧甲以兜鍪、披膊與身甲為主，並配橫刀（隋人亦稱拍刀）作近身格鬥；騎兵用馬槊、弓箭與刀，馬上披甲從簡而以馬鐙、韁帶為主；重裝備還有槊、鋒、鎬等兵器，以及雲梯、撞車等攻城器械。行軍序列裡編入大量牛車與駝馬運糧，帳幕以氈氈張搭。黨項與吐谷渾一方則是典型的草原裝備：短刀、弓矢、革甲、皮盾，長矛少而短矛多，馬匹是他們最重要的武器，帳落隨水草遷徙。
kitsEn: The Assyrian spear on the card is a socketed weapon: a short haft, a long blade and an iron head, carried by the Assyrians together with bow and ironwork as a universal arm both in the field and under the walls. By Sui times this type of short-hafted socketed spear had long been overtaken in China by the simpler iron spear and the plain iron point, and an Assyrian spear itself would never have appeared on a battlefield in the Hexi; the card therefore stands for the equipment of a spear line rather than for a physical object. What the Sui host actually carried was layered. In the infantry: iron spears, ge, ji, small shields of the ban-dun type, arm bows and tension bows, and armour made up of a helmet, shoulder guards and a body defence, with the horizontal sword, also called the pai dao, for close work. In the cavalry: the ma shuo, the bow and the sword, with horses fitted with stirrups and bridles rather than heavy barding. There were also cold weapons such as the shuo, the feng and the gao, and siege gear including scaling ladders, battering rams and tower carts. The marching columns took ox-carts and pack animals for grain and pitched felt tents. The Tangut and Tuyuhun, by contrast, carried the standard steppe kit: short swords, bows, leather armour and hide shields, few long spears and many short ones, with the horse itself the decisive weapon and the tent-clan moving on with the water and the grass.
tactics: 隋軍這次用的是典型的多道合擊與縱深追擊。第一步是分進合擊：主力由益州沿岷江、松州一線北上，另一路由河西諸郡出祁連山北麓，兩路在青海湖一帶合攏，把吐谷渾與黨項各部夾在青海與積石山之間的草場上。第二步是依賴輕騎的搜打與驅趕：隋軍以大量騎兵巡獵於草場，切斷各部落之間的聯繫，迫其向指定地點集中，再由主力收拾。第三步是主力會戰：步騎混編成大陣，前列以弓弩齊射覆蓋，繼而以步卒持短柄鐵矛結陣前推，騎兵自兩翼突入，於近身搏鬥中解決戰鬥。第四步是追與撫並用：對吐谷渾殘部窮追於山谷，對黨項則一面搜捕散眾、一面開出歸附的通道，把受降部眾編入郡縣、交給校尉監護，並許其保留帳落與牧地，如此用最小的駐軍換取邊境的安寧。糧秣靠隨軍車隊與沿途徵發維持，遠距離作戰使補給線拉得極長，這也是隋軍不敢深入、只在青海一線作戰的原因之一。
tacticsEn: The Sui used a classic combination of converging columns and pursuit at depth. First the approach: the main body went north from Yizhou along the Min river and through Songzhou, while a second column came out of the Hexi commanderies along the northern foot of the Qilian, and the two met around Qinghai Lake, squeezing the Tuyuhun and the Tangut onto the pastures between the lake and the Jishi range. Then the manoeuvre of light cavalry: riders swept the grasslands, cutting the tribes off from one another and driving them toward points the Sui had chosen, leaving the main force to settle them. Then the general engagement: the host was drawn up in a combined line, the front ranks covered the ground with a volley of bows and tension bows, the infantry with short iron spears at the ready advanced in a solid formation, and the cavalry drove in from both flanks to finish at close quarters. Last came pursuit and inducement used together: the Tuyuhun remnants were chased into the gorges, while for the Tangut the Sui hunted down the scattered bands and at the same time opened a road of surrender, settling the compliant into commanderies and counties under military wardens and allowing them to keep their tent-clans and their grazing grounds. The object was to buy quiet on the frontier with the smallest possible garrison. Supply came with the marching carts and by levy along the route, and the long haul of provisions was one reason the army did not push deeper than the shores of Qinghai.
data: 可核的數字不多，且多半來自《隋書》與《資治通鑑》的概括記載。兵力方面，主流記載稱蜀王楊秀所率為步騎二十餘萬，另有較小的數字作十餘萬，兩說並存而無從折衷；面對的吐谷渾精騎當在數萬之眾，屬於全族皆兵的部落軍。距離方面，自益州治成都到戰場所在的星宿川，直線距離不足八百公里，但須翻越松潘與羌地山道，實際行軍里程遠在千公里以上；軍隊自開皇十五年二月出師，至夏初才班師，途中大半時間耗在行軍與整頓。時間與物資方面，隋朝自開皇元年受禪至開皇十五年已有十四年，經開皇前期的休養與平陳之後的積蓄，府庫尚能支撐這樣一支遠征大軍，但史家也指出此役的轉輸之費，遠超一次邊防反擊的常規規模。人數方面，黨項降附時的部眾數目與首領姓名均未見記載，傳世文獻只留下「內附」二字。這一場戰爭的量化記錄，實際上是由吐谷渾那一側的記載撐起來的。
dataEn: The verifiable numbers are few, and most of them come in summary form from the Book of Sui and the Comprehensive Mirror. On strength: the standard account gives the force under Yang Xiu as more than two hundred thousand foot and horse, while a smaller figure of a hundred-odd thousand also circulates, and the two cannot be reconciled; the Tuyuhun riders facing them were, by the nature of a tribal host in which every man could ride, in the tens of thousands. On distance: from Yizhou, that is Chengdu, to the field at Xingsuchuan is under eight hundred kilometres as the crow flies, but the route crosses the Songpan country and the Qiang mountains, so the marching distance ran well over a thousand kilometres; the army set out in the second month of Kaihuang 15 and did not return until the beginning of summer, most of that time spent on the road and in reorganisation. On time and resources: fourteen years had passed since the Sui took the throne in 581, and after the recovery of the Kaihuang years and the stores built up after the fall of Chen, the treasury could still carry a host of that size, though historians note that the cost of transport for this expedition far exceeded that of an ordinary frontier counter-attack. On numbers of men: the size of the Tangut following and the names of their chiefs are simply not recorded; the transmitted literature preserves only the phrase that they came in and submitted. In effect the quantitative record of this war is carried by the Tuyuhun side.
cause: 打起來的原因有三層。最外層是邊境上的實際衝突：開皇年間，吐谷渾與黨項各部不斷進入涼州、河州、鄯州、廓州一帶，攻掠邊郡、驅趕牲畜，河西走廊的驛路與鹽道屢受干擾，邊軍疲於奔命而不能自守。第二層是隋朝自身的戰略：平陳之後，隋廷視河西為經營西北的前哨，而吐谷渾正扼住通往西域的門戶，並與西突厥往來密切，若不先擊破吐谷渾，隋朝在西邊的經營就無從落實，屯田與驛傳也無從設置。第三層是黨項自身的處境：黨項各部力量分散，長期在與吐谷渾及其他諸羌爭奪牧地中進退失据，謀生不易；當隋朝大軍壓境、草原各部崩散之際，歸附一支能給出牧地安置與官職的強權，是最省力的出路。於是出現了戰役中最耐人尋味的一幕：同一支大軍，遇上吐谷渾時是追擊，遇上黨項時卻是大肆招撫，而兩者之間的差別，正是隋廷對「能不能編管」的判斷。
causeEn: There were three layers of reason. The outermost was the actual friction on the frontier: throughout the Kaihuang years the Tuyuhun and the Tangut bands rode into the commanderies of Liang, He, Shan and Kuo, raiding the border counties and driving off livestock, while the post road and the salt road of the Hexi corridor were repeatedly disturbed and the frontier troops were kept too busy to defend themselves. The second layer was Sui strategy: after the conquest of Chen, the court treated the Hexi as the forward post for the north-west, and the Tuyuhun held the gateway to the western regions while keeping close ties with the Western Turks; until Tuyuhun was broken, Sui could not fix its footing in the west, nor establish garrisons, farms and post stations. The third layer was the Tangut's own position: their tribes were divided and had long been squeezed in contests for pasture with the Tuyuhun and with other Qiang neighbours, and when a Sui host of enormous size came over the mountains and the tribal order broke up, going over to a power that would assign pasture and rank was the cheapest way out. Hence the strangest feature of the campaign: the same army that chased the Tuyuhun was, when it came to the Tangut, overwhelmingly in the business of offering terms, and the difference between the two lies in the Sui court's judgement about who could be administered.
impact: 對隋朝而言，這一役的直接結果是打開了青海湖一帶的門戶：隋廷在吐谷渾與黨項的牧地上置州郡與軍鎮，設校尉與監護官，把原本互不統屬的諸部放進帝國的編戶與羈縻框架裡，這在隋代邊疆史上是一次制度性的開端，也是唐代羈縻州制度的先聲。對黨項來說，這是第一次大規模被中原王朝編管：受降部眾得到安置，部分內遷到河州、鄯州一帶的農業地帶，首領被授以官爵，與隋廷形成帶有互相利用性質的關係；此後數百年，族名與拓跋姓氏結合，經唐宋的羈縻、邊鎮與內遷，到十一世紀末形成西夏政權，隋代這一步在其中的分量並不輕。從戰略史的角度看，隋朝以一次大規模遠征解決了邊患，卻也消耗了府庫與民力，其後對吐谷渾的用兵在大業年間仍要延續，說明單憑一次遠征解決邊疆問題的效力有限。
impactEn: For the Sui the immediate effect was to open the region around Qinghai Lake. The court set up prefectures, commanderies and military posts on the pastures of the Tuyuhun and the Tangut, and placed wardens and inspectors over peoples who had previously owed no obedience to anyone, drawing them for the first time into the Sui system of registration and loose control; this was a constitutional beginning in Sui frontier history and the precedent of the Tang jimi system. For the Tangut this was the first time they were administered on a large scale by a Chinese dynasty: the compliant were resettled, some moved inward to the farming country of He and Shan, their chiefs received titles, and a relationship of mutual use was established with the court. Over the following centuries the tribal name was joined to the surname Tuoba, and through the jimi prefectures, the frontier commands and the inward movement of the Tang and Song, gave rise to the Western Xia state at the end of the eleventh century; the Sui step in that sequence is not a trivial one. From the point of view of the history of war, the Sui solved a frontier problem with one great expedition and in doing so drained the treasury and the people; the continuation of the war against Tuyuhun into the Daye years shows how limited the effect of a single distant expedition could be.
result: 打完之後的局勢是這樣的：吐谷渾遭重創，都汗伏允收拾殘部退保祁連、積石深處，部眾四散，隋軍得其牲畜器械甚多，但沒有佔領其全部國土；吐谷渾此後仍以小股游騎不時擾邊，直到大業年間隋廷派人處置伏允，其勢才衰。黨項各部則大批內附，隋朝對受降者授官、編戶、置郡縣，並以校尉監護其眾，邊境由戰時的對抗轉為羈縻式的管理，這是這場戰爭真正改變了什麼的地方。對隋文帝本人而言，此役是一次成功的邊疆軍事行動，邊患暫時緩解，疆域向西拓展；代價則是二十餘萬大軍的長途轉輸，以及此後年年不斷的邊防開支。兩面放在一起看，這是一場以武力開路、以招撫收尾的戰爭：亞述長矛所代表的那一類短柄鐵鏃長矛，雖然不在隋朝的武器庫裏，但它所屬的裝備，正是隋軍在青海高原上列陣與衝鋒時真正握在手裏的東西。
resultEn: The situation after the fighting was this. The Tuyuhun were badly hurt; the khagan Fu Yun gathered what was left of his people and withdrew into the recesses of the Qilian and the Jishi, the tribes scattered, and the Sui took a great deal of their livestock and gear without occupying the country as a whole. Tuyuhun continued to appear on the frontier in small mounted bands until the Sui court removed Fu Yun in the Daye years and the state declined. The Tangut bands, by contrast, came in and submitted in large numbers; the Sui granted titles, registered them as people, established commanderies and set wardens over the settled groups, and the frontier changed from open war to administration by loose control, which is the part of the campaign that truly changed something. For Emperor Wen himself it was a successful frontier action: a respite from the border trouble and an extension of the empire westward, at the price of transporting an army of more than two hundred thousand men over a thousand kilometres and of frontier expenditure that never stopped afterwards. Taken together, this is a war that opened by force and closed by inducement. The Assyrian spear on the card is not in the Sui armoury, but the class of equipment it represents, the short haft and the iron point, is exactly what the Sui foot soldier held when the line was closed on the high plain of Qinghai.
